intro.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
intro.text: Satie, 1888: “slow and sorrowful”. The left hand swings between a low bass note on beat 1 and a chord on beat 2. The melody floats over it, mostly in long notes.

intro.title: The bass leap
intro.text: The left hand jumps an octave or more every bar. Look at the next bass note, not your hand, and let the chord on beat 2 be quiet.
